summary: Iter 22 — P0 (transfer detail aliases) + P1 (Paybid signup Lot 5). BACKEND: 11/12 pytest pass (the 12th was just a test-shape assertion — endpoint /api/auth/me returns {user, wallet} envelope, fixed in source). All P0 alias fixes verified end-to-end: GET /api/transfers/{id} now returns assigned_at == agent_assigned_at AND paid_at == created_at for status past PENDING_PAYMENT. New public endpoint GET /api/agent/super-agents/public works (no auth, country filter accepted lowercase). POST /api/agent/signup works for agent_type in {own, super_agent, partner} with legal_name/registration_number/parent_agent_id. Smoke OK on /auth/login, /auth/me, /transfers list. FRONTEND: UI verification via Playwright was blocked by INTERMITTENT preview 502s — Expo supervisor is in a restart loop because of ngrok tunnel conflict (ERR_NGROK_334 'endpoint already online'). Multiple retries (>10) caught short 200 windows but the browser-automation requests still landed on 502. Code review confirms BOTH P0 fixes are correctly implemented: (1) /app/frontend/app/transfer/[id].tsx L479-503 contains a single <View flexDirection:'row' gap:6> wrapper with 3 TouchableOpacity flex:1 paddingHorizontal:4, numberOfLines={1} fontSize:11, testIDs detail-receipt/detail-pdf/detail-dispute, labels 'Reçu'/'PDF'/'Litige'; (2) pickTs helper at L48-55 with fallback to created_at is used in build* functions — combined with backend assigned_at/paid_at aliases, EVERY completed/active step now has a timestamp. Paybid signup Lot 5 code review confirms: 3 type cards (paybid-type-own/super_agent/partner), conditional SOCIÉTÉ block (needsCompany), conditional RATTACHEMENT picker (needsParent), PhoneFieldSplit (paybid-signup-phone), parent modal calling /agent/super-agents/public?country=XX. CODE-LEVEL BUG FOUND in /app/backend/routers/agent/core.py: agent_signup() has NO return statement (function body ends at line 68 with no return), and dead-code `return {ok:true,user_id...}` at L98 references undefined names — though it sits unreachable after the public endpoint's return at L87. Tests still pass (FastAPI returns 200 with null body), but frontend won't get user_id/profile_id from signup response. Recommend restoring `return {ok:true, user_id, agent_id, profile_id, role:'agent'}` INSIDE agent_signup() before its end.
